'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution incidents]]
***At least 12 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 29 others are injured by [[Israel]]i fire near two [[humanitarian aid|aid distribution]] sites in the [[Gaza Strip]]. The [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli military]] says they fired warning shots at people who had advanced toward its forces and ignored warnings to turn away but claimed they did not see any casualties. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israel-hamas-war/article/palestinians-say-5-killed-by-israeli-fire-near-aid-sites-israel-says-it-fired-warning-shots/ (CTV News)]
*[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
**One person is killed and two others are injured in an Israeli airstrike on [[Mazraat Beit Jinn]], [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]], [[Syria]]. The Israeli military claims the person killed was a [[Hamas]] member. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/8/israel-strikes-syria-again-claims-to-have-killed-alleged-hamas-member (Al Jazeera)]
*[[June 2025 Los Angeles protests]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] orders the deployment of the [[National Guard of the United States|National Guard]] to quell anti-[[Deportation in the second presidency of Donald Trump|deportation]] protests in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-presidency-news-06-07-25 (CNN)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[78th Tony Awards]]
**The 78th [[Tony Awards]] take place at [[Radio City Music Hall]] in [[New York City]], [[United States]], with [[Theater in Korea|South Korean]] musical ''[[Maybe Happy Ending]]'' winning the most awards (six), including [[Tony Award for Best Musical|Best Musical]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/stage/2025/jun/09/tony-awards-2025-maybe-happy-ending-and-nicole-scherzinger-win-big-while-george-clooney-misses-out (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Cundinamarca earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|6.3}} earthquake strikes near [[Bogotá]], [[Colombia]], resulting in over 25 injuries. [https://boyaca7dias.com.co/2025/06/08/al-menos-25-personas-lesionadas-y-la-destruccion-de-un-templo-y-30-casas-dejo-en-colombia-el-sismo-de-magnitud-65/ (Boyacá 7 Días)]
*[[2025 San Diego Cessna 414 crash]]
**All six occupants are killed after a [[Cessna 414]] crashed into the ocean off the coast of [[Point Loma, San Diego|Point Loma]] after takeoff from [[San Diego International Airport]] in [[San Diego, California]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/plane-crash-san-diego-coast-guard-search-missing-people/ (CBS News)]
*A [[derecho]] and [[tornado]] outbreak begins in the [[eastern United States]], with three tornado warnings and 22 severe [[thunderstorm]] warnings. [https://www.foxweather.com/weather-news/dallas-texas-oklahoma-severe-weather-hail-wind-plains-june-2025 (Fox News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 French Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Spain|Spanish]] player [[Carlos Alcaraz]] wins his second [[2025 French Open – Men's singles|men's singles title]] at the [[French Open]] and his fifth [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|Grand Slam]] overall after defeating [[Italia]]n [[Jannik Sinner]] 4–6, 6–7<sup>(4–7)</sup>, 6–4, 7–6<sup>(7–3)</sup>, 7–6<sup>(10–2)</sup> in the longest-ever French Open final at five hours and 29 minutes. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/c0eqjpzq972o (BBC Sport)]
*[[2025 UEFA Nations League final]]
**In [[association football]], [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]] defeats [[Spain national football team|Spain]] 5–3 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]], following a 2–2 draw after [[Overtime (sports)|extra time]], to win its second [[UEFA Nations League]] title. [[Nuno Mendes (footballer, born 2002)|Nuno Mendes]] is named [[Player of the match|man of the match]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cvgqzyl24j4t (BBC Sport)]
